why_ai: Screen-based credit, funding and servicing work; licensing, fair lending accountability and dealer relationships protect the firm more than the staff.
why_clarity: Approvals, fundings and collections are codified and recur by the thousand, but losses resolve over months to years.
why_digital: Applications, contracts and loan data in and money out to dealers, though dealer reps and physical collateral keep a local element.

why_ai: Engines already decide most prime paper; human judgement survives only at the non-prime margin.
why_clarity: Each decision is a structured approve/counter/decline with early-default feedback in months.
why_digital: Dealer applications in through networks, decisions out on screen.

why_ai: Prime approvals are already automated and the remaining review is routine verification.
why_clarity: Near-identical applications with codified policy and measurable loss and booking rates.
why_digital: Fully electronic from dealer submission to decision.

why_ai: Counteroffers are adversarial negotiations with dealers who game grids, judged on slow loss outcomes.
why_clarity: Senior analysts structure by feel, though deals recur and early defaults give partial feedback.
why_digital: Screen-based negotiation with dealers by portal and phone.

why_ai: Captive programs are tied to dealer relationships and manufacturer strategy, with residual and credit judged together.
why_clarity: Credit is codified for small tickets, but residual outcomes arrive years later.
why_digital: Applications and financials on screen, with dealer counters, site visits and physical equipment collateral.

why_ai: Rule checks against documents are exactly what document AI is absorbing.
why_clarity: A checklist applied to thousands of near-identical packages with pass/fail outcomes.
why_digital: Contract packages, scans and eContracts reviewed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Recovery coordination is screen work, but state law, physical vehicles and liability for wrongful repossession keep humans accountable.
why_clarity: Notices, sales and deficiencies follow state rules with measurable net recovery.
why_digital: Vendor portals and letters on screen, around physical vehicles moved by agents and auctions.

why_ai: Owner relationships with local dealers and warehouse banks are the product, though the back office is automatable.
why_clarity: Credit, servicing and reporting are routine, but policy lives in the owner's head.
why_digital: Paper deal jackets and legacy systems, with dealers and lenders met in person.

why_ai: Serving borrowers without files needs judgement, community trust and fair lending care that models cannot yet supply.
why_clarity: Methods vary by lender and outcomes take years on thin data.
why_digital: Paper evidence and bilingual phone servicing through local dealers.

why_ai: Deterministic reports from loan-level data are directly automatable.
why_clarity: Prescribed reports on fixed dates with reconcilable, checkable numbers.
why_digital: Loan data in, reports and files out to banks and trustees electronically.

why_ai: Refunds are calculations from contract terms and state rules.
why_clarity: Every refund has an exact correct answer computable from the terms.
why_digital: Contract images and servicing data in, refunds and filings out on screen.

why_ai: Modelling waterfalls and normalising remittances is codifiable, though investors pay for the trusted model library.
why_clarity: Each deal model is checked against monthly remittances with objective tie-outs.
why_digital: Filings and tapes in, models and analytics out by subscription.

why_ai: Lenders rely on named appraisers and benchmark guides; field appraisals need inspections.
why_clarity: Values are checked against auction results continuously.
why_digital: Auction and listing data in, guides and appraisals out, with some site inspections.

why_ai: Fraudsters adapt and pooled cross-lender data is a moat AI strengthens.
why_clarity: Scores are measurable against confirmed fraud, but new schemes need investigative judgement.
why_digital: Pooled application data in, scores and alerts out by API.

why_ai: Attorney-edited interpretation carries some professional weight, but subscription content is the kind of work AI-native publishers can increasingly produce.
why_clarity: Each statutory change is distinct and interpretations are tested only in enforcement.
why_digital: Statutes in, digital manuals and alerts out by subscription.

why_ai: The furnished tradeline file is the moat; the analysis on top is automatable.
why_clarity: Market share and delinquency benchmarks recur quarterly with objective definitions.
why_digital: Tradeline data in, reports and analytics out remotely.

why_ai: Insurer backing and program history sustain it, though the decision itself is a model.
why_clarity: Repeated risk-pricing decisions with claims outcomes over the loan term.
why_digital: Application data in, insured decisions out through lender systems.

why_ai: Network analytics are software on transaction flow the platform does not own.
why_clarity: Indices and benchmarks recompute the same way on every period.
why_digital: Transaction data in, dashboards and indices out online.

why_ai: Investment judgement on pool pricing is high-stakes with slow feedback and relationship-driven deal access.
why_clarity: Pool diligence repeats, but returns are known only after years.
why_digital: Tapes and models on screen, with originator relationships and negotiations.

why_ai: Sample comparison of tape fields to contracts is mechanical and automatable.
why_clarity: Each field either matches the document or does not.
why_digital: Tapes and contract images in, exception reports out.

why_ai: Custody of original documents and fiduciary accountability keep a physical and liable element.
why_clarity: File checks against tapes are exact and recur on every funding.
why_digital: Paper contracts and titles held physically, with reporting on screen.

why_ai: Member trust and advocacy sustain associations; surveys themselves are automatable.
why_clarity: Annual surveys recur, with quality hard to check.
why_digital: Member submissions in, reports out online.

why_ai: Only state officials can license, examine and discipline lenders, a function that persists regardless of AI.
why_clarity: Licensing and examination rules are codified and recur, though enforcement outcomes are slow and negotiated.
why_digital: Filings and records reviewed largely on screen, with some on-site examination and no commercial buying.
